
paragraphs = paragraph [[NIhO ... # paragraphs|NIhO ... # paragraphs]] 

paragraph = (statement | fragment) [[I # [statement  fragment|statement  fragment]] ... 

''fragment'' has been reduced to ''statement''.

''statement'' has been reduced to ''subsentence''.

We now have:

(subsentence) [[I # [subsentence|subsentence]]: reduces to "jo'u gi subsentence gi subsentence" which is a ''subsentence''.

(If the second ''subsentence'' is not present after an I, use "co'e".)

After reducing every ''paragraph'' to ''subsentence'', we reduce ''paragraphs'', starting from the innermost:

subsentence [[NIhO ... # subsentence|NIhO ... # subsentence]]: reduces to "jo'u gi subsentence gi subsentence"

Thus ''paragraphs'' is reduced to ''subsentence''.
